warrior.intro: This is a free Warrior talent calculator for World of Warcraft®: Forever™. Open the full Arms, Fury, and Protection trees, spend all 51 points under Forever rules, then copy a share link. Talent names and every rank description are read from client build 1.60.1.70425, checked 16 October 2026.

sections.heading: How Warrior talent points work in Forever
paragraphs: At level 60 you have 51 talent points. Those points are one shared pool across Arms, Fury, and Protection — not 51 per tree.

Inside a single tree, spending 5 points unlocks the next row. Locked rows stay grey until that gate is met. Talents also respect maxRank (1–5) and prerequisite links: you cannot rank a talent until its requirement is filled.
The calculator blocks overspend. Used and remaining points update as you click.

sections.heading: Arms, Fury, and Protection trees
paragraphs: This page lists 52 Warrior talents in our dataset: 17 in Arms, 17 in Fury, 18 in Protection. Every name and rank text is prerendered in the HTML so you (and crawlers) can read them without running the interactive grid.
Use the trees above to try Arms-heavy, Fury-heavy, or Protection-heavy splits. Nothing on this page claims a single “correct” PvE or PvP build — that would need live tuning data we do not invent.

sections.heading: What changed for Warrior vs Classic?
paragraphs: Against Classic Era in our diff file, Warrior shows 11 new talents, 18 changed, 10 moved, and 13 unchanged. Examples of new nodes include Spearing Strike, Bloodthrill, and Weaponmaster. Changed examples include Improved Rend, Improved Tactical Mastery, and Anger Management. Moved examples include Improved Overpower, Improved Execute, and Improved Berserker Rage.

Open the change list on this page for the full crawlable set, or open an individual talent page for every rank description. Counts come from data/talents.json for class warrior — not from competitor pages.
When the client build moves, check the beta changelog for what we rebuilt.

sections.heading: Plan, save, and share a Warrior build
paragraphs: Each point you spend updates the address bar. Copy that URL, or use Copy link, to restore the same ranks in another browser via a real path under /warrior/build/ — not a hash fragment.

Drafts also stay in local storage on this device (clearing site data removes them). Reset and undo are available in the calculator chrome when you need to restart a theorycraft pass. Talc cannot import or export an in-game talent string — plan here, then apply ranks in the client yourself.
If you are comparing classes before locking a main, the home hub links all nine calculators, including Paladin and Hunter beside Warrior.

faqs.q: How many Warrior talents are in Forever?
faqs.a: This calculator lists 52 Warrior talents across Arms, Fury, Protection (17 / 17 / 18), read from client build 1.60.1.70425, checked 16 October 2026.

faqs.q: How do Warrior talent points work?
faqs.a: At level 60 you have 51 points shared across all three trees. Within one tree, each new row opens after 5 points spent in that tree. Prerequisites and maxRank still apply.

faqs.q: What changed for Warrior vs Classic?
faqs.a: In our dataset, Warrior has 11 new, 18 changed, 10 moved, and 13 unchanged talents versus Classic Era. The change list on this page links every marked talent.

faqs.q: Does Talc pick the best Warrior build?
faqs.a: No. Talc is a planning tool. It does not publish unverified BiS, DPS rankings, or leveling presets. Spend points on the trees, then share your own link.

faqs.q: Where is my draft saved, and can I import a game build?
faqs.a: Drafts stay in this browser’s local storage on this device. Clearing cookies or site data removes them. Share links restore ranks on any browser. Talc cannot import talent strings from the game client.

faqs.q: Is Talc official, and do I need an account?
faqs.a: Talc is an unofficial fan-made tool, not affiliated with Blizzard. It is free and does not require an account.

druid.intro: This is a free Druid talent calculator for World of Warcraft®: Forever™. Open the full Balance, Feral Combat, and Restoration trees, spend all 51 points under Forever rules, then copy a share link. Talent names and every rank description are read from client build 1.60.1.70425, checked 16 October 2026.

sections.heading: How Druid talent points work in Forever
paragraphs: At level 60 you have 51 talent points. Those points are one shared pool across Balance, Feral Combat, and Restoration — not 51 per tree.

Inside a single tree, spending 5 points unlocks the next row. Locked rows stay grey until that gate is met. Talents also respect maxRank (1–5) and prerequisite links: you cannot rank a talent until its requirement is filled.
The calculator blocks overspend. Used and remaining points update as you click.

sections.heading: Balance, Feral Combat, and Restoration trees
paragraphs: This page lists 52 Druid talents in our dataset: 16 in Balance, 20 in Feral Combat, 16 in Restoration. Every name and rank text is prerendered in the HTML so you (and crawlers) can read them without running the interactive grid.

Use the trees above to try Balance-heavy, Feral-heavy, or Restoration-heavy splits. Nothing on this page claims a single “correct” PvE or PvP build — that would need live tuning data we do not invent.

sections.heading: What changed for Druid vs Classic?
paragraphs: Against Classic Era in our diff file, Druid shows 15 new talents, 13 changed, 20 moved, and 4 unchanged. Examples of new nodes include Genesis, Nature's Majesty, and Nature's Splendor. Changed examples include Improved Moonfire, Insect Swarm, and Vengeance. Moved examples include Improved Wrath, Moonglow, and Nature's Reach.

Open the change list on this page for the full crawlable set, or open an individual talent page for every rank description. Counts come from data/talents.json for class druid — not from competitor pages.
When the client build moves, check the beta changelog for what we rebuilt.

sections.heading: Plan, save, and share a Druid build
paragraphs: Each point you spend updates the address bar. Copy that URL, or use Copy link, to restore the same ranks in another browser via a real path under /druid/build/ — not a hash fragment.

Drafts also stay in local storage on this device (clearing site data removes them). Reset and undo are available in the calculator chrome when you need to restart a theorycraft pass. Talc cannot import or export an in-game talent string — plan here, then apply ranks in the client yourself.
If you are comparing classes before locking a main, the home hub links all nine calculators, including Warrior and Paladin beside Druid.
